label: main season
summary: E1 is a weak indirect, second-hand report of land-use cessation after an armed group camped at the site; it neither confirms EO nor establishes safe use. Cancellation criteria are not met, and after only one visit this weaker indirect evidence should be followed up through further non-technical survey before deciding whether it is explained or becomes a clearance target. The zone flag and survey priority are not evidence.
flags: On the next visit, seek first-hand information about the reported armed-group presence and the land-use history, and determine whether E1 can be explained.
No direct evidence is recorded; the report alone does not establish contamination.

checks.detail: Further non-technical survey is always open.

E1.quote: people stopped using the land at the edge of the pasture after an armed group camped there around 2006, and nobody has used it since.
E1.note: A reported land-use change after armed-group presence suggests possible contamination but does not confirm EO; the statement does not establish that the informant personally witnessed the event, so treat it as second-hand.
